Every analysis follows three phases:

### 1. Analyze
Run API functions. Each call hits the Google APIs and returns structured data.

### 2. Auto-Save
All results automatically save as timestamped JSON files to `results/{category}/`. File naming pattern: `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS__operation__extra_info.json`

### 3. Summarize
After analysis, read the saved JSON files and create a markdown summary in `results/summaries/` with data tables, trends, and recommendations.

## High-Level Functions

### GA4 Analytics

supplemental_boundaries.audit_requirement: Source declares reading saved JSON and writing markdown summaries; these TypeScript files have no dedicated markdown summary writer. Audit source-level coverage separately.
Setup command is source evidence only. It is excluded from the 13 awaited application SDK-site denominator and is never executed by this audit.

field_necessity_checks.title: Settings demand must distinguish consumers
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: Formatting a property ID needs propertyId; choosing Search Console site needs siteUrl; storage needs resultsDir and the actually serialized propertyId. Neither full settings reads nor credential presence automatically establish demand for unrelated fields.

field_necessity_checks.title: Validation conditions must survive semantic minimization
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: propertyId/clientEmail/privateKey presence affects validation.valid and errors. If a validation requirement is semantically wrong for one client, report the mismatch explicitly instead of pretending the source never checks it.

field_necessity_checks.title: Documented filters and orderBy are ignored by actual runReport

sources.quote:
Run a custom GA4 report with arbitrary dimensions and metrics.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `options.dimensions` | `string[]` | required | GA4 dimension names |
| `options.metrics` | `string[]` | required | GA4 metric names |
| `options.dateRange` | `string \| DateRange` | `"30d"` | Date range |
| `options.filters` | `Record<string, string>` | `undefined` | Dimension filters |
| `options.orderBy` | `string[]` | `undefined` | Sort order |
| `options.limit` | `number` | `undefined` | Row limit |
| `options.save` | `boolean` | `true` | Save results to JSON |

**Returns:** `Promise<ReportResponse>` — Rows with dimension and metric values.

### `getPageViews(dateRange?)`

field_necessity_checks.expected_review: filters/orderBy are destructured but absent from request and all later computations. If the declared task requires filtering/sorting, report unsupported or missing behavior; deletion of these source inputs does not repair that behavior.

field_necessity_checks.title: Output-specific metadata dependency
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: getAvailableDimensions returns/saves only dimensions; getAvailableMetrics only metrics; getPropertyMetadata preserves the whole response. A whole-response transfer rule cannot stand in for either selective case. Source lacks a remote response projection parameter.

field_necessity_checks.title: Inspection result demand is consumer-specific
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: Standalone inspectUrl exposes indexStatus/mobileUsability/richResults/link. checkIndexStatus calls it with save=false and keeps verdict plus the whole indexStatus; other inspection fields have no use on this consumer path, but other consumers may require them.

field_necessity_checks.title: Notification fallback and output pairing
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: Output URL can derive from response or original URL. Time can derive from response or clock. reindexUrls object spread can overwrite the earlier url field; do not assume a fixed input-output URL equality unsupported by the source.

field_necessity_checks.title: Repeated URL calls and error branches
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: Three loops require occurrence/cardinality/order identity. requestIndexingBatch has no local catch; the two high-level loops append per-member error outcomes. Removing a URL can alter count, effects, status and console observations.

field_necessity_checks.title: Bulk lookup empty input and membership
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: Empty normalized URLs return rows=[]/rowCount=0 before client/API/save. Nonempty normalized members feed the filter. Preserve membership, caseSensitive=false, optional metrics and date range.

field_necessity_checks.title: Storage action and return-value demand are separate
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: The 25 saveResult call sites do not use its filepath return. Required persistence must still retain filename, payload and write action; unused return does not mean unused side effect.

field_necessity_checks.title: Other consumers and acquisition control
field_necessity_checks.expected_review: compareDateRanges retains both ranges and reports while disabling two inner saves. Report/analytics selectors may constrain acquisition but do not establish arbitrary response-field trimming. Union all applicable uses before deleting an input.

field_necessity_checks.title: Documented output mismatch remains visible
